newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to bump against 127.10 upper barrier.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to bump against 127.10 upper barrier.

text.p: June BTPs on LIFFE will be capped on Tuesday by resistance close to current highs, after a strong performance on Monday, technical analysts said.
"We rebounded off major support yesterday, and we are heading for 127.00/127.10 today," said Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch International in London.
"But there is no strong directional sentiment in Europe, as shown by the lack of open interest and volume over the last three weeks," he added.
June BTPs were trading at 126.60 at 0744 GMT, down 0.10, after earlier reaching a session high of 126.98.
The 127.00/127.10 area represents the base of April's trading range until it broke down on Friday, and now provides the cap, Hobson said.
"There are very severe price reversals, and the market is overbought on an intraday basis," he added.
David Wood, independent technical analyst near London, also found resistance at the 127.00/127.10 trendine.
"I think we would be doing well to get through there, but if we get some momentum going we could get as high as 127.85."
The contract has fallen through initial support at 126.70, and further support lies at 126.35 down to 126.20, Wood said.
Hobson also finds support for the contract within that range, at around 126.25.
Further down, there is little support before Friday's low at 125.80, analysts said.
June Eurolira futures were three basis points higher at 93.10 at 0757 GMT.
"A close through 93.20 at this stage would be bullish," said a European bank in a technical note.
